integrity.mathematical_proof: group character orthogonality, Clebsch-Gordan McKay recurrence, 60-step character identity, element-order tightness classification, degree-12 invariant injection and finite exact recurrence witnesses
integrity.reproducibility: CHECK.py uses Python 3 with NumPy and reproduced 241 assertion groups; the infinity claim does not rely on numerical enumeration
integrity.source_basis: earliest date-verified public source listed is arXiv:1010.1827v1 (2010-10-09); arXiv:1307.6768v1 (2013-07-25) supplies the 600-cell and labelled affine E8 graph

scientific_limitations: Single exact spherical-harmonic degree on the 120-vertex unit 600-cell only; interpolation is onto the antipodal-parity-compatible 60-dimensional subspace, not all 120 coordinates.
Gram is the unnormalized Chebyshev character matrix; a probability-normalized surface reproducing Gram has an additional factor of degree plus one.
Perfect tightness is exactly at degrees congruent to 29 modulo 30; asymptotic tightness otherwise follows from the 60-step shift; sharp all-residue conditioning constants are not claimed.
Some older symmetrized-icosahedral representation studies were not available in complete text, leaving residual priority uncertainty.
Numerical eigenvalue checks are finite corroboration; independent mathematical validation has not occurred.
title: Parity-sharp exact-degree harmonic sampling on the 600-cell
